Shrawani Singh

Email: shrawani.data@gmail.com Mob: +91-8817780906 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shrawani-singh-aiml/

Summary: •

Senior Data Scientist with 7+ years of experience across Fintech, Banking, leading projects that apply generative AI (GPT, LLMs, RAG) for tasks like text analysis, conversational AI, and anomaly detection model. Proficient in data science modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytics, with deep experience in Python, AWS Kinesis, Sagemaker, and Transformer models for Chatbot, Anomalies detection, fraud detection and risk analysis. Proven track record in implementing custom embeddings, underwriting models, and scorecard development for improving financial products and strategies. Extensive experience working as Lead/Senior Data scientist in artificial intelligence & machine learning based solution design, requirements analysis, estimation, development and deployment for global leading banking, fintech, agriculture, cosmetics, data storage and data integrations clients. In-depth hands-on experience in deploying and customizing machine learning models using Python, transformer-based models, Fast API, FLASK, Docker for integrating ML Models into different environments, ensuring robust and scalable AI systems.









Role & Responsibilities: Tech Lead/Senior Data Scientist • Work with business and developers in the development of solutions, targeted at complex projects. •

Applied advanced statistics and core experimental design (A/B testing, hypothesis testing, regression) on large-scale datasets to drive product strategy and insights. Analyse the complex business needs of clients and convert them to functional and technical specifications. Ensure best practices are followed and support development teams with technical expertise. Agile best practices, including Sprint backlog establishment and prioritization, technical design and estimates for project enhancement. Conduct design and code reviews, perform model hyperparameter tuning, refactor ML model, evaluate and adopt new tools, manage vendor collaborations, and present model status and insights to business stakeholders. Lead and provide training and best practices advice to both new and experienced Data Scientists and ML Engineers.

• •





Domain Skills &Technologies:

Technologies/Languages: Python, Pandas, Numpy, Scikit, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch , Spacy, OpenCV • Machine Learning: NLP, Embeddings, Information Value, Recommendation Engines, Event Rate, Ensemble, hypertuning • LLMs and GenAI: RAG, GPT-based models, Faiss, Llama-index, Transformers, LoRA fine tuning LLMs, encoder-decoder, , vLLM, Deepspeed, text similarity, TensorRT, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, and hyperparameter tuning Tools/techniques: MLFLow, Kubernetes, Docker, A/B testing, Hypothesis Testing, AWS, Azure, Jupyter Notebook, Streamlit,



Certifications:

• • • •

Certified with PGP/AIML from Texas University Certified on ML Projects Certified on Data analytics projects AWS certified Cloud Practitioner Certified in Cloud computing

Employment History: London Stock Exchange Persistent Systems L&T Infotech

| Dec 2022 – Present | Jan 2021 – Dec 2022 | July 2017 – Jan 2021

| Tech Lead / Senior Data Scientist | Senior Data Scientist | Data Scientist

London Stock Exchange (Platform)

LSEG, Bengaluru

Dec 2022- Present

Role: Technical Lead/Senior Data Scientist

Responsibilities: Evaluated technical and solution feasibility of system changes, overseeing model development, algorithm design, data modeling, training, and implementation. • Developed and implemented advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to optimize



trading data for portfolio management. Collaborated with quantitative analysts and stakeholders to identify data-driven opportunities and enhance Eikon product performance on the Deming platform.

Designed and deployed anomaly detection algorithms with automated workflows, improving efficiency and accuracy of data quality monitoring. Applied product analysis and A/B testing to compare anomaly detection strategies, reducing false positives and strengthening system reliability. Reduced false positives by 20% and improved anomaly detection speed by 30%.





London Stock Exchange (LLM ChatBot)

LSEG, Bengaluru

Jan 2023- Jan 2024

Role: Technical Lead/ Senior Data Scientist Responsibilities: Designed and developed AI-driven solutions for customer support through chatbot, focusing on NLP and model deployment. Developed a holistic chatbot leveraging Llama 2 Quantized Version for NLP. •

Integrated Faiss as a vector database for efficient data handling and utilized Chainlit for the chatbot’s user interface Trained the chatbot on client-specific resolutions for enhanced customer support and engagement regarding product inquiries which helped in increasing query resolution accuracy by 35% and reduced average response time by 40%.



Persistent Systems (Admissions)

Persistent Systems, Bengaluru.

Jan 2021- Dec 2022

Role: Senior Data Scientist /Lead SWE Responsibilities: Led risk consulting and growth strategies for consumer portfolios and SMEs, including reject inferencing analysis, fraud detection (XGBOOST, Random Forest), and microfinance scorecard development for top banks. • Developed behaviour and solvent scorecards for subprime markets, applying WOE and IV techniques to predict customer



behaviour and identify fraud. Built lead prioritization systems and real-time recommendation engines for upsell opportunities, enhancing customer targeting and sales effectiveness. Improved fraud detection accuracy by ~18%, reducing financial risk exposure for client banks.

L&T Infotech (Data & Analytics)

L&T Infotech, Mumbai

Aug 2017- Jan 2021

Role: Data Scientist Responsibilities: Analyzed consumer behavior and sales data in the cosmetics domain, converting business needs into functional and technical specifications. • • Developed lead prioritization models to identify high-value customers for upsell and cross-sell opportunities. •

Built customer segmentation and campaign response scorecards to enhance targeting and maximize marketing ROI.

Conducted product analysis and A/B testing of marketing strategies, uncovering high-performing campaigns that boosted engagement. Boosted campaign engagement by 15% and improved conversion rates by 10%.

Education:

Bachelor of Computer Science & Engineering (2013 – 2017), RGTU

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Summary: •
Senior Data Scientist with 7+ years of experience across Fintech, Banking, leading projects that apply generative AI (GPT, LLMs, RAG) for tasks like text analysis, conversational AI, and anomaly detection model. Proficient in data science modelling, machine learning, and advanced analytics, with deep experience in Python, AWS Kinesis, Sagemaker, and Transformer models for Chatbot, Anomalies detection, fraud detection and risk analysis. Proven track record in implementing custom embeddings, underwriting models, and scorecard development for improving financial products and strategies. Extensive experience working as Lead/Senior Data scientist in artificial intelligence & machine learning based solution design, requirements analysis, estimation, development and deployment for global leading banking, fintech, agriculture, cosmetics, data storage and data integrations clients. In-depth hands-on experience in deploying and customizing machine learning models using Python, transformer-based models, Fast API, FLASK, Docker for integrating ML Models into different environments, ensuring robust and scalable AI systems.




Role & Responsibilities: Tech Lead/Senior Data Scientist • Work with business and developers in the development of solutions, targeted at complex projects. •
Applied advanced statistics and core experimental design (A/B testing, hypothesis testing, regression) on large-scale datasets to drive product strategy and insights. Analyse the complex business needs of clients and convert them to functional and technical specifications. Ensure best practices are followed and support development teams with technical expertise. Agile best practices, including Sprint backlog establishment and prioritization, technical design and estimates for project enhancement. Conduct design and code reviews, perform model hyperparameter tuning, refactor ML model, evaluate and adopt new tools, manage vendor collaborations, and present model status and insights to business stakeholders. Lead and provide training and best practices advice to both new and experienced Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
• •


Domain Skills &Technologies:
Technologies/Languages: Python, Pandas, Numpy, Scikit, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch , Spacy, OpenCV • Machine Learning: NLP, Embeddings, Information Value, Recommendation Engines, Event Rate, Ensemble, hypertuning • LLMs and GenAI: RAG, GPT-based models, Faiss, Llama-index, Transformers, LoRA fine tuning LLMs, encoder-decoder, , vLLM, Deepspeed, text similarity, TensorRT, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, and hyperparameter tuning Tools/techniques: MLFLow, Kubernetes, Docker, A/B testing, Hypothesis Testing, AWS, Azure, Jupyter Notebook, Streamlit,
